SiteConfig.title: SiteConfig
SiteConfig.description: Global Quran Reels platform configuration controlled exclusively by the master admin farouk.gabal@gmail.com.

siteTitle.description: Platform brand title displayed in header and footer.

sadaqahLabel.description: Official Sadaqah Jariyah dedication phrase across the site and default video footer.

heroHeadline.description: Main headline displayed in the hero section.

heroSubtitle.description: Supporting description displayed below the hero headline.

announcementBanner.description: Optional site-wide announcement or prayer banner published by the admin.

defaultSurahId.description: Default Surah number (1-114) loaded in the studio.

defaultFromAyah.description: Default starting Ayah number loaded in the studio.

defaultToAyah.description: Default ending Ayah number loaded in the studio.

defaultBackgroundId.description: Default visual background identifier from catalog.

allowPublicCustomSadaqah.description: Whether public visitors can customize the Sadaqah Jariyah text on their exported videos.

isPublishedLive.description: Whether the public studio is live or temporarily paused in maintenance mode by the admin.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the exclusive master administrator.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp of initial configuration creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest administrative publish or edit.

PublishedPreset.title: PublishedPreset
PublishedPreset.description: Curated Quranic passage preset published and managed exclusively by the master admin.

titleArabic.description: Display title of the Quranic preset.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the master admin creator.

AdminProfile.title: AdminProfile
AdminProfile.description: Private PII-isolated record of the sole administrator farouk.gabal@gmail.com holding all roles and permissions.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Verified administrator email address (must be farouk.gabal@gmail.com).

roleSummary.description: Full Arabic title of administrative authority.

/site_config/{configId}.description: Singleton global configuration document (/site_config/main) publicly readable via get and writable exclusively by farouk.gabal@gmail.com.

/published_presets/{presetId}.description: Curated Quranic Reels presets publicly readable when status == 'published' and fully managed exclusively by farouk.gabal@gmail.com.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Private administrator identity and authority record isolated from public reads and accessible exclusively by farouk.gabal@gmail.com.
